brief.headline: Close the 326.9% price gap on laminates — our ₹1067.36/KG is four times Silk Polypack's ₹250.00/KG and six times the import benchmark of 171.60 ₹/kg.

priceAsk.summary: Target ₹250.00/KG to match our best price; minimum bring us to the import line of 171.60 ₹/kg
priceAsk.basis: Current ₹1067.36/KG carries a 326.9% premium over our best laminate price and runs 6× the BOPET film import unit value of 171.60 ₹/kg — this is converter markup on top of substrate, not raw material cost

paymentTermAsk.summary: Hold at 30 Days After Receipt — no extension

brief.financialLeverage: Huhtamaki India runs 5.2% net margin and 8.3% EBITDA margin with minimal leverage at 0.11x debt-to-equity and 12.0% return on capital — a healthy, growing business (22.5%/yr revenue growth per lever data) with ₹2611.64 Cr revenue and a C (59/100) health score. We are ₹76850 spend, 0.00% of their revenue — zero standalone leverage. They don't need our volume to survive, but their growth appetite means they'll trade price for committed volume. Push hard on price but frame it as a qualification for scale: match the market or we move volume to UFLEX or Constantia Parikh who can deliver pharma-grade laminates at reasonable cost.

evidence.point: Our laminate price is 326.9% above our best price
We overpay ₹58850 annually on laminates versus our best price
BOPET film import benchmark is 171.60 ₹/kg — our price is 6× raw substrate cost
We are an immaterial customer — 0.00% of their ₹2611.64 Cr revenue
Huhtamaki is financially stable with low leverage and positive margins
evidence.figure: 5.2% net margin, 8.3% EBITDA margin, 0.11x debt-to-equity, C (59/100) health

alternates.name: UFLEX Ltd
alternates.why: Listed flexibles giant at ₹16492.00 Cr revenue, both film substrate AND conversion capability, can second-source laminates at scale — health C (46/100)

alternates.name: Constantia Parikh Packaging Pvt Ltd
alternates.why: Global Constantia group India converter, ₹222.04 Cr revenue, specializes in pharma blister/sachet laminates — credible GEEP alternative despite D (31/100) health

alternates.name: Amcor Flexibles India Pvt Ltd
alternates.why: Global Amcor India arm, high-end pharma laminates — premium but very reliable second source for qualification

risks: We have zero leverage at 0.00% of their revenue — they can walk away; bundle this negotiation with a volume commitment or multi-SKU RFQ to create something worth their time

The 326.9% gap suggests we may be buying a specialty pharma-grade laminate structure that Silk Polypack at ₹250.00/KG cannot match on specification — validate like-for-like before quoting the gap in the room
Huhtamaki's 22.5%/yr growth and healthy margins mean they are not desperate for volume — frame the ask as market alignment and qualification for scale, not a price squeeze
If we push too hard with no leverage, they simply decline to quote next time — position alternates (UFLEX, Constantia) as active trials to show we will move volume
brief.suggestedOpeningLine: We're here to close a 326.9% price gap on laminates — our ₹1067.36/KG is four times what we pay Silk Polypack and six times the BOPET import line, so let's talk about how we get to a market price and scale the relationship.
